verdict.rationale: The chat-completion docs describe an interactive experience where you can compare two models' outputs side-by-side and switch between UI view and code snippets. A probe also confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published at /.well-known/openapi.json. That points to interactive, runnable exploration of the API, but the evidence does not show a full browsable API reference with try-it-now examples across endpoints. missing for 10: an explicitly documented interactive API reference covering all endpoints, runnable in-browser examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Easily switch between UI view and code snippets.
Compare the output of two models side-by-side.
